name: junoguard
install: python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r backend/requirements.txt && python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -e './mcp' -e './cli' && npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix packages/junoguard
start: sudo service docker start || sudo dockerd >/tmp/dockerd.log 2>&1 & sleep 1

terminals.name: gateway
terminals.description: JunoGuard FastAPI gateway on :8000 (mock-friendly without secrets). Health: /health, readiness: /ready.

terminals.name: dashboard
terminals.description: Vite dashboard on :5173. Point VITE_API_URL at http://localhost:8000 for local gateway.
